safety_property_not_claimed: A daemon whose owner generation is stale cannot mutate checkpoint, workorder, staging, receipt, or materialized state.
minimal_stale_owner_trace: Daemon A acquires owner row with caller epoch E and pauses.
A reaches expiry without releasing or renewing the row.
Daemon B observes expiry and overwrites the row with its own owner ID; the schema does not require B epoch > E.
A resumes and invokes a scheduler mutator carrying workorder lease evidence but no current owner capability.
The mutator obtains SQLite write serialization yet does not reject A as a stale daemon owner.
required_correction: Mint a strictly increasing owner generation transactionally from durable database state.
Propagate owner ID and generation as explicit mutation capability fields.
Inside every BEGIN IMMEDIATE mutation transaction, verify session, owner ID, generation, held state, and expiry before writes.
Bind externally visible file effects to a currently validated owner or a transactionally reserved operation capability.
Reject stale generations independently of caller clock.
Add deterministic pause-A/reclaim-B/resume-A tests and a small state-machine model.
